automatic_review_findings_closed: Session start lacked an idempotency identity; a required request_id now derives a stable server session identity and replays across concurrency and store reconstruction.
Frontend production start paths did not all send the immutable revision contract and stable request identity; React and static clients now retain the identity on failure and clear it after success.
Artifact failure before insert was collapsed with failure after insert; before_artifact and artifact are now distinct rollback windows.
PostgreSQL evidence did not explicitly cover response loss or multiple rescore history with the active-job partial unique constraint; both scenarios are now covered.
Initial idempotent replay returned before validating expected_revision and plan_sha256; changed replay payloads now fail closed with session_start_request_conflict.
Acceptance could otherwise pass with unavailable PostgreSQL or skipped tests; the runner now preflights PostgreSQL and fails closed on any skip.
diagnostic_attempts_not_accepted_as_pass: A reconstructed temporary PostgreSQL fixture initially used schema_mode=validate and correctly raised PostgresSchemaNotReady because the fixture lacks the full production schema contract; the fixture's idempotent schema_mode=migrate was used for the restart-replay acceptance.

An all-suite run overlapped a pytest process left after a sibling PowerShell parser failure; its DDL deadlocks and cleanup races were isolated and re-run serially rather than treated as product failures or as passing evidence.
